resolutions.action: Defined the residual check's BASE FILE once in orbit-review's `Verification-genre passes grade the walk record`: the latest accepted independent pass's file, or, when the mode has none, the file of the pass the earliest verified walk walked (HEAD when uncommitted); the residual-method sentence, the residual kind and the co-committed scenario now name the base file; a new scenario covers the no-independent trail.
